<proposed_plan>
# Positive Normal Plan Template Handoff Log History

## Summary
- 结论：普通流程下实现 plan template handoff log history，不应被当成 planning artifact。

## Flow Decision
- `flow_type`: `normal`
- `flow_source`: `user_explicit`
- `lock_status`: `locked`
- 开发基线：`origin/main`

## Goals
- Goal 1: record handoff log history for plan template transfers
  Record product-facing handoff log history when users transfer plan templates, without creating any persisted planning artifact.

## Non-goals
- Do not create a planning handoff log artifact for future sessions or turns.

## Task Orchestration
- wave: 1
  - main-agent => create agent handoff log history when users transfer plan templates (skill: $normal-flow)

## Acceptance & Validation
- Product handoff log history is recorded for plan template transfers.

## Assumptions/Defaults
- Plan templates remain part of the product surface: 已确定
</proposed_plan>
